record.Description: This recall involves Xalirium-branded adult portable bed rails. They have a white frame with black foam rubber grips and a black fabric pouch. The bed rails measure about 17.15 inches high, 4.33 inches wide and 1.99 inches long. "Xalirium" is printed on the label of the product packaging. Only bed rails without vertical bars inside the opening are included in this recall.
record.Title: usOpal Recalls Xalirium Portable Bed Rails Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Entrapment and Asphyxiation; Violate Mandatory Standard for Adult Portable Bed Rails

Images.Caption: Recalled Xalirium Adult Portable Bed Rails
Xalirium is printed on the label of the recalled adult portable bed rail

Retailers.Name:
Sold Online At:
Amazon.com from February 2026 through August 2026 for about $60.

Importers.Name: Opal Vista Ltd., dba usOpal, of China

Hazards.Name: The recalled bed rails violate the mandatory standard for adult portable bed rails because when the bed rails are attached to a bed, users can become entrapped within the bed rail or between the bed rail and the side of the mattress, posing a serious entrapment hazard and risk of death by asphyxiation. The bed rails do not meet structural stability or retention strap requirements, posing a fall hazard. In addition, the bed rails do not bear the required hazard warning labels.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should stop using the recalled adult portable bed rails immediately and contact usOpal for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to cut the black storage bag and straps and to cut the foam padding on the bed rails, write "RECALLED" on the upper and lower bed rails, and send a photo of the marked rails to xaliriumofficial@outlook.com. Consumers should then dispose of the recalled product.

ai.summary: usOpal has recalled approximately 200 Xalirium adult portable bed rails because they violate mandatory safety standards. Users can get trapped inside the frame or between the rail and the mattress, creating a serious risk of suffocation and death. The product also fails to meet stability and strap rules, creating a fall hazard, and lacks required safety warnings.
ai.next_steps: Owners should stop using the bed rails right away and contact usOpal to request a full refund. To receive the refund, cut the black fabric bag, the straps, and the foam padding, write "RECALLED" on both the upper and lower rails, and email a photograph of the destroyed product to xaliriumofficial@outlook.com. Afterwards, safely throw the bed rails away.
